key: Welcome to the South Obsidia Low Income Community Estate-- or SOLICE for short.
en: Welcome to the South Obsidia Low Income Community Estate-- or SOLICE for short.
ja: 南オブシディア低所得者向けコミュニティ団地――略してSOLICEへようこそ。

key: Here we offer high-quality but low-cost studio and one-bedroom rental spaces in return for a weekly volunteer schedule.
en: Here we offer high-quality but low-cost studio and one-bedroom rental spaces in return for a weekly volunteer schedule.
ja: ここでは、週ごとのボランティア活動と引き換えに、質は高いのに低価格なワンルームや1ベッドルームの賃貸スペースを提供しています。

key: Everyone deserves SOLICE in their time of need, and now they can have it in return for volunteer time in helping either us or the community.
en: Everyone deserves SOLICE in their time of need, and now they can have it in return for volunteer time in helping either us or the community.
ja: 困ったときには誰もが安らぎ(SOLICE)を受ける資格があります。今では、私たちや地域社会を助けるボランティアの時間と引き換えに、それを手にすることができるんです。

key: I beg your pardon though, you seem familiar.
en: I beg your pardon though, you seem familiar.
ja: 失礼ですが、どこかで見覚えがある気がします。

key: Oh! You're the person who laid down the funding to finish this place, aren't you?
en: Oh! You're the person who laid down the funding to finish this place, aren't you?
ja: ああ! この場所を完成させるための資金を出してくださった方ですよね?

key: It's an honor to meet you!
en: It's an honor to meet you!
ja: お会いできて光栄です!

key: I'll tell you what, when the folks at the Grand Hall told me one person had donated the entire rest of our goal's cost, I was pretty floored.
en: I'll tell you what, when the folks at the Grand Hall told me one person had donated the entire rest of our goal's cost, I was pretty floored.
ja: 正直言うと、大ホールの人たちから、目標額の残り全部を一人の方が寄付してくれたと聞いたときは、本当に驚きました。

key: But this has been a passion project for me for years, you know?
en: But this has been a passion project for me for years, you know?
ja: でも、これは何年も前からわたしが情熱を注いできたプロジェクトなんです。

key: I just never thought it would be possible!
en: I just never thought it would be possible!
ja: 実現できるなんて思ってもいませんでした!

key: From the bottom of my heart, thank you.
en: From the bottom of my heart, thank you.
ja: 心の底から、ありがとうございます。

key: I'm sure all of our clients feel the same way.
en: I'm sure all of our clients feel the same way.
ja: 利用者みんなも、きっと同じ気持ちだと思います。

key: I do wish I could repay you, but I'm afraid I don't really have much time or funding to offer since I put it all into this place.
en: I do wish I could repay you, but I'm afraid I don't really have much time or funding to offer since I put it all into this place.
ja: 何かお返しできればいいのですが、時間もお金も、ほとんどこの場所につぎ込んでしまって……

key: Ahh, this may not be worth anything, but I suppose you have a better chance of determining that than I do.
en: Ahh, this may not be worth anything, but I suppose you have a better chance of determining that than I do.
ja: ああ、大した価値はないかもしれませんが、それを判断するのは、わたしよりあなたのほうが向いているはずです。

key: One of the residents turned in this key. They said they found it somewhere, but it doesn't belong to us.
en: One of the residents turned in this key. They said they found it somewhere, but it doesn't belong to us.
ja: 住人の一人がこの鍵を届けてくれたんです。どこかで見つけたと言っていましたが、うちのものではありません。

key: On the chance that it leads somewhere nice, I hope you can make some use of it.
en: On the chance that it leads somewhere nice, I hope you can make some use of it.
ja: 何か良いところにつながる鍵かもしれません。役立ててもらえればうれしいです。

key: From the bottom of my heart, thank you. I'm sure all of our clients feel the same way.
en: From the bottom of my heart, thank you. I'm sure all of our clients feel the same way.
ja: 心の底から、ありがとうございます。利用者みんなも、きっと同じ気持ちだと思います。

key: If there's anything I can do for you, don't hesitate to let me know-- though I can hardly imagine you'd be in need of housing.
en: If there's anything I can do for you, don't hesitate to let me know-- though I can hardly imagine you'd be in need of housing.
ja: 何かできることがあれば、遠慮なく言ってください――もっとも、あなたが住まいに困っているとは思えませんが。

key: Though I can hardly expect you to do any more for us than you already have--
en: Though I can hardly expect you to do any more for us than you already have--
ja: もう十分すぎるほどしていただいたので、これ以上をお願いするのも心苦しいのですが――

key: We do have positions open!
en: We do have positions open!
ja: 実は、募集中の仕事があるんです!

key: I would not be surprised if someone as generous as yourself were interested in looking at a service position, or had connections with others who are.
en: I would not be surprised if someone as generous as yourself were interested in looking at a service position, or had connections with others who are.
ja: あなたほど気前の良い方なら、支援職に興味があったり、そういう人に心当たりがあったりしても、驚きません。

key: But feel free to take an application if you think you might be interested.
en: But feel free to take an application if you think you might be interested.
ja: 興味があれば、気軽に申込書を持っていってください。

key: Hello there. If you'd like to get enrolled in our program, you can speak to the boss to my left.
en: Hello there. If you'd like to get enrolled in our program, you can speak to the boss to my left.
ja: こんにちは。プログラムへの登録をご希望なら、わたしの左にいる責任者に声をかけてください。

key: Otherwise I can log your volunteer hours here, check you in, or handle any other requests you might have.
en: Otherwise I can log your volunteer hours here, check you in, or handle any other requests you might have.
ja: それ以外でしたら、ここでボランティア時間の記録やチェックイン、その他のご用件にも対応できます。

key: Tell you what, job hunting the old fashioned way just doesn't cut it anymore, huh?
en: Tell you what, job hunting the old fashioned way just doesn't cut it anymore, huh?
ja: ぶっちゃけ、昔ながらのやり方の就活じゃ、もう通用しないよな。

key: Most places put their applications online only, but if we need a job, how they expect us to have a computer?
en: Most places put their applications online only, but if we need a job, how they expect us to have a computer?
ja: たいていの会社は、応募をネットだけで受け付けてるけど、仕事が必要な俺たちに、パソコンなんてあると思ってんのか?

key: Well I guess that's what this place is for now.
en: Well I guess that's what this place is for now.
ja: まあ、それがこの場所の役目ってわけだ。

key: Shoot, it's been years since I got any kind of real work, but this volunteer stuff is tiring.
en: Shoot, it's been years since I got any kind of real work, but this volunteer stuff is tiring.
ja: くそ、まともな仕事に就いたのはもう何年も前だってのに、このボランティアってやつは疲れるぜ。

key: They keep workin' us with the city to fix up stuff for restoration and that's cool and all, but brother, if I have to fetch one more load of bricks...
en: They keep workin' us with the city to fix up stuff for restoration and that's cool and all, but brother, if I have to fetch one more load of bricks...
ja: 市と一緒に復興の作業ばっかりやらされてて、そりゃ悪くはないけどよ、なあ、あとレンガをもう一往復運ばされたら……

key: ...Well I dunno, but I ain't gonna be happy.
en: ...Well I dunno, but I ain't gonna be happy.
ja: ……まあどうなるかわからねえけど、絶対キレるぞ。

key: KID: Ohh shit, you're--
en: KID: Ohh shit, you're--
ja: 少年: うわ、やべ、お前――

key: Ah, nothin'. I wasn't talking to you, go away!
en: Ah, nothin'. I wasn't talking to you, go away!
ja: あ、何でもねえ。お前に言ったんじゃねえよ、あっち行け!

key: 'Less you wanna throw down.
en: 'Less you wanna throw down.
ja: ケンカしたいってんなら別だけどな。

key: I ain't afraid to smack a bitch.
en: I ain't afraid to smack a bitch.
ja: 女だろうがぶちのめすのなんて怖くねえぞ。

key: You gonna scoot?
en: You gonna scoot?
ja: とっとと消えるか?

key: Nawwh!
en: Nawwh!
ja: んなっ!

key: KID: Awwwh, shit. I shouldn'ta said anything to begin with.
en: KID: Awwwh, shit. I shouldn'ta said anything to begin with.
ja: 少年: ああ、くそ。最初から何も言うんじゃなかった。

key: I recognized you as the one that got scammed of that rare Pokémon back in the Grand Hall a while back.
en: I recognized you as the one that got scammed of that rare Pokémon back in the Grand Hall a while back.
ja: 前に大ホールでレアなポケモンをだまし取られたやつだって、気づいちまってさ。

key: I figured, it ain't stealing if it's already stolen, so I spun a trick and made off with that rare Pokémon myself.
en: I figured, it ain't stealing if it's already stolen, so I spun a trick and made off with that rare Pokémon myself.
ja: もう盗まれたもんなら盗みにはならねえだろって思って、一芝居打って、そのレアなポケモンを自分でかっぱらったんだよ。

key: Bought a week's worth of food from sellin' it to some gang member up in North Obsidia though. Gangs up there pay good cuz they take from Lapis.
en: Bought a week's worth of food from sellin' it to some gang member up in North Obsidia though. Gangs up there pay good cuz they take from Lapis.
ja: 北オブシディアのギャングに売って、1週間分の食い扶持を稼いだけどな。あそこのギャングはラピスから巻き上げてる分、金払いがいいんだ。

key: Don't you hate. I turned over a new leaf since then, but we do what we do to get by, you know what I mean?
en: Don't you hate. I turned over a new leaf since then, but we do what we do to get by, you know what I mean?
ja: 恨まないでくれよ。あれから心を入れ替えたけど、生きていくためにはやることやるしかねえだろ、わかるか?

key: Anyway, Pokémon's not on me anymore, sorry mate!
en: Anyway, Pokémon's not on me anymore, sorry mate!
ja: とにかく、そのポケモンはもう手元にねえよ、悪いな!

key: KID: I recognized you as the guy that got gypped that rare Pokémon back in the Grand Hall a while back.
en: KID: I recognized you as the guy that got gypped that rare Pokémon back in the Grand Hall a while back.
ja: 少年: 前に大ホールでレアなポケモンをだまし取られたやつだって、気づいたんだ。

key: A stack of job applications for SOLICE sits on the counter.
en: A stack of job applications for SOLICE sits on the counter.
ja: カウンターにはSOLICEの求人応募用紙が積まれている。

key: Take one?
en: Take one?
ja: 1枚もらいますか?

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい
